record_title: Optimality of 9/22 among parity-restricted rainbow Schur colorings
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to 3-colorings in which all even integers have one color and every odd integer uses one of the other two; it does not settle the unrestricted rainbow-Schur problem. Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating arXiv preprint is extremely recent, so an unindexed contemporaneous follow-up remains a residual risk. No independent validation is asserted.
